title: Example Set Examples List Response Schema
description: 200 body of GET /api/v1/example-sets/{set_id}/examples after TraigentBackend#3353. The route now returns `response_handler.paginated_response(...)` — {success, message, data: {items, pagination}} (src/utils/response_handler.py:288-296, :349-356). Before #3353 it emitted a bare {examples, current_page, per_page, total_examples, total_pages} with no envelope (src/routes/example_set_routes.py:349-357); that form is gone, and `examples`/`current_page`/`total_examples` no longer exist on the wire. x-wrap-status: wrapped — one of the two enveloped operations in the otherwise-bare `example_set_routes` (see success_envelope_schema.json#/x-wrap-map/mixed). The item shape is Example.to_dict() (src/models/agent.py:338-349) and is deliberately NOT a $ref to example_set_schema.json#/definitions/Example: that closed definition requires a non-null `output`, declares a `metadata` field the serializer never emits, and omits `explanation` / `tags` / `tenant_id` / `project_id` / `example_set_id`, all of which this serializer does emit.

success.description: Discriminator — always true for success responses.

message.description: Human-readable summary; "Examples retrieved successfully" from this route.

data.description: Nested paginated payload. `pagination` lives HERE, not at the top level — paginated_response is strict nested-only.

pagination.description: Canonical {page, per_page, total, total_pages, has_next, has_prev}. `per_page` is clamped to [1, 100] by the route (src/routes/example_set_routes.py:340).

SerializedExample.description: Exactly what Example.to_dict() emits (src/models/agent.py:338-349). Every key is always present; nullability follows the column definitions at src/models/agent.py:313-333.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant; the caller's own, because the parent set is owner-scoped before the query runs (src/routes/example_set_routes.py:333-336).

input.description: Input text or prompt. NOT NULL column.

output.description: Expected/reference output. NULLABLE — the column has no nullable=False (src/models/agent.py:331), which is why example_set_schema.json#/definitions/Example's `required: [example_id, input, output]` cannot describe this payload.

explanation.description: Free-text rationale supplied with the example; user-authored content, not declared by example_set_schema.json at all.

tags.description: Untyped JSON column (JSONType) — passed through unchanged, so the wire type is whatever was stored.
